To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the culture system that best maintained EAF morphology, COC quality, and the percentage of COCs with oocytes in the germinal vesicle stage was the WOW inverted system; 2) the WOW inverted system resulted in a greater proportion of oocytes that were competent to undergo meiosis and to produce blastocysts following IVF and culture; 3) the WOW inverted culture system was more efficient in maintaining EAF morphology and COC quality than the standard system; and

the use of the WOW culture system with a microdroplet collagen gel and culture of EACs in inverted hanging drops of medium resulted in the highest proportion of COCs with a normal morphology and meiotic resumption rate after IVM.
the WOW system, the microdroplet of 2 x 5-μl gel and inverted system were the most effective culture systems in preserving EAF and isolated COCs morphology and meiotic capacity.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a culture system for bovine EAF that will maintain the three-dimensional organization of the follicles and increase the number of COCs with morphologically normal cumulus and oocytes.

the development of a culture system for early antral ovarian follicles that maintains the three-dimensional structure and increases the number of oocytes with normal morphological quality and the proportion of COCs with the first polar body (PB1) extrusion following in vitro maturation.
the effects of the different culture systems on cumulus and the oocyte morphology and the oocyte competence to undergo maturation in vitro.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the present study has established a culture system that will maintain the three-dimensional architecture of bovine EAF or isolated COCGs and increase the resulting proportion of COCs with morphologically normal cumuli and oocytes.
the culture of bovine early-antral follicles in a WOW system with a microdroplet (2 x 10 μl) of collagen gel is the best culture method for bovine early-anstral follicle growth and development.
the culture of bovine EAF in the WOW system with a collagen gel and in inverted hanging drops resulted in significantly better morphological and meiotic competence compared with the standard system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the culture of bovine early EAF and COCs in the WOW system and in inverted culture dishes, respectively, resulted in a higher proportion of oocytes with normal morphology and a higher proportion of COCs with expanded cumulus cells.

culture of EAF or isolated COCGs in collagen microdroplets (2 x 2 μl) in the WOW system, or in inverted hanging drops, resulted in a significantly higher (P A) portion of COCs that retained the cumulus cell mass, and that were able to resume meiosis and mature to metaphase II.

we have developed an in vitro culture system for early antral (0.2-0.7 mm) bovine follicles that maintains the three dimensional structure of follicles, increases the proportion of oocytes with normal morphology for in vitro maturation, and increases the proportion of matured oocytes with a normal morphology for subsequent embryo production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to culture EAFs for a longer period of time in vitro than has previously been reported.
the use of a hanging drop system to culture bovine early anstral follicles (0-1 mm in size) can be used to maintain follicle structure for up to 7 days in culture.

the culture of bovine EAFs in the WOW system and in collagen gels in hanging drops of maturation medium is a simple and effective method to maintain the three-dimensional follicular structure and increase the portion of COCs of normal morphology and oocytes with normal meiotic and developmental competence.
